name: Wand of Binding

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Assisted Escape
powers.text: Reaction, 1 charge: Advantage on a save to avoid being Paralyzed or Restrained, or on a check to escape a grapple (used automatically).

summary: 7 charges: Hold Monster (5) or Hold Person (2) at DC 17; a charge gives Advantage against being held.
text: This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed. Spells. While holding the wand, you can cast one of the following spells (save DC 17) from it: Hold Monster (5 charges) or Hold Person (2 charges). Assisted Escape. While holding the wand, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge and give yourself Advantage on a saving throw you make to avoid being Paralyzed or Restrained, or you can expend 1 charge and give yourself Advantage on any check you make to escape a grapple.
